prompt: English has become the main language of international business, science and travel. Some people see this as a practical advantage, while others believe it threatens smaller languages and the cultures attached to them. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
In the today world, the English language is used everywhere for the business, the science and the tourism. Some people say that this is a very useful thing, but other people say that it is dangerous for the small languages and the cultures. This essay will discuss the both views before giving my opinion.

On the one hand, English brings many benefits. If two persons from the different countries meet, they can communicate in English even if they do not know the language of each other. This is very useful for the international business, because the companies can make the contracts easily. In addition, almost all of the scientific researches are published in English, so the scientists from all over the world can read them and share the knowledge. Also, the students who know English can study in the famous universities abroad. They can also find the better job in the international companies, because all of the managers there speak English.

On the other hand, some people worry about the small languages. Every year many languages are disappeared because the young generation prefer to learn English instead of the language of their grandparents. When a language dies, the culture also dies, because the songs, the stories and the traditional knowledge are lost forever. This is a very big loss for the humanity.

In conclusion, English has the many advantages for the communication, but it also has the disadvantages for the small languages. In my opinion, the people should learn English but they should not forget their mother tongue, because the both of them are important.
title: English as a world language
